issues.text: New sentence (2026-11-11) splits causes into 'Some' on the dashboard and 'The rest' with no alert, then the next sentence gives 'A few causes' a ticket. A failed restore test is neither on donhang-api.json (six panels, none for it) nor without an alert: alerts.md line 75 plans it as a ticket. 'The rest' therefore overstates; 'like CPU or Pod restarts' is only an example, not a limit.
issues.quote: The rest, like CPU or Pod restarts, get no alert; if they hurt customers, an SLI alert fires.
issues.fix: Replace 'The rest, like CPU or Pod restarts, get no alert' with 'Others, like CPU or Pod restarts, get no alert'; keep the rest of the sentence.
